author: potuz
content:
because the setup is as follows:

Deathstar recognizes it will propose twice in a row, say N and N+1. You also hold keys for an active builder. 

1) Takes a bid from your own builder with a trustless payment. 
2) attest to your block. 
3) Withhold the payload
4) The next proposer introduces a slashable attestation for the same block with wrong target.
